decisions.reason: Restricting red color usage for the Elon Musk article does not alter the requirement to enhance image quality when needed.
The article color restriction does not change the obligation to request additional images when needed to balance article layouts.
The visual color correction does not change the required digital flipbook PDF deliverable.
The source changes article color usage but does not modify the digital magazine launch deadline.
The Elon Musk article color restriction does not change author names, photographs, sizing, coverage, or photo sources.
Reserving red for the magazine cover does not affect flipbook hosting cost or candidate platform selection.
